# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC13 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Branch/head: not a Git repository; checkpoint is file-manifest based.

## Scope

RC13 adds a task inspection safety slice for remote iPad/Blink use:

- `V` at the task trust prompt opens a read-only `Task Details: NAME` IDE view
  instead of running the task.
- `:task-info NAME` opens the same read-only view directly.
- The details view shows the configured `argv`, configured and resolved working
  directory, environment overrides, the direct no-shell execution model, and the
  reminder that actual execution still requires one-time trust.
- The trust prompt footer now advertises `V details` alongside `Y trust once &
  run` and `Esc cancel`.
- README and the real-iPad QA matrix document the task-detail route.

This does not make workspace tasks sandboxed; it gives the operator a
keyboard-first inspection gate before trusting workspace-provided code.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is local automated and binary/package proof only.

It does not claim the defining hardware route is accepted. The remaining open
gate is a real iPad Magic Keyboard session in Blink Shell over the intended
mosh/SSH path, with exact Blink version, transport, tmux state, route,
installed `w` binary hash, language-server binary/version if used, and human
feel results recorded in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
